title: Finite global torus rank obstruction at the coefficient-4 endpoint

proof_mechanism: Rounded locally finite neck dips give λ4≥2 by D=R+2Δw−|dw|²≥2 and the ground-state identity with v=1/f. Dip tests ζ/f have bounded Q4 and gradient energy ≥1/(72δj), forcing λa=−∞ below 4. The finite-warp scalar formula reduces any lower bound to a positive supersolution for coefficient ak=4k/(k+1)<4.

costs: Exact analytic proof; no numerical or oracle cost. The dip scale tends to zero along one sequence.
